scoring_justification: Full recomputation from raw DFT outputs infeasible in lightweight checker sandbox; scoring uses structural ordering (AFM3 ground state) and value tolerances.

hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: direct transcript of reported total-energy differences
direct transcript of reported Cr magnetic moments

hidden_assets.purpose: gold lattice constants a, c for AFM3
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: direct transcript of reported optimized lattice parameters for AFM3

hidden_assets.purpose: gold VRH bulk modulus for AFM3
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: direct transcript of reported bulk modulus B_VRH for AFM3

hidden_assets.purpose: gold total DOS at Fermi level for AFM3
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: direct transcript of reported N(E_F)_total = 2.54 states/eV·f.u.

required.delta_E: object containing keys NM, FM, AFM1, AFM2, AFM3, each a numeric value in eV/f.u.
required.magnetic_moments: object containing keys FM (number), AFM1 (array of two numbers), AFM2 (number), AFM3 (number); all in μB
required.lattice_constants_AFM3: object with keys a and c, both numbers in Å
required.dos_at_fermi_total: number, in states/eV per formula unit

schema.notes: All numeric fields must be finite and match the described units. The JSON structure must exactly follow the required keys.

outputs.description: Aggregated results from DFT calculations: energy differences, magnetic moments, AFM3 lattice constants, bulk modulus, and DOS at the Fermi level.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare each numeric entry in results.json against hidden reference values derived from the paper, with appropriate tolerances that account for the use of a different DFT code (Quantum ESPRESSO vs. VASP) and pseudopotential library. All values are to be reported in the units specified.
